task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to make an effort to head west. And then, try to move west. Following that, go to the south. And then, attempt to take a trip east. After that, go to the east. And then, go to the north. With that done, try to take a trip north. After that, go west. If you can do that, venture south. After that, take a trip south. Then, try to take a trip east. After that, retrieve the coin from the floor of the office. And once you've done that, you win!
